events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam's Big Day
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment, musical or otherwise?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971, featuring his signature peace anthem.

angles.name: Imagine 55th
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Apple introduced the first iPod 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, forever changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Quarter Century
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago, Apple introduced the first iPod. It put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's Global James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007. What's your favourite Bond film or theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon 86 Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Cleese 87 Laughs
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album 58th
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, iconic 'White Album'. A true masterpiece that broke new ground. What's your standout track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary Queen frontman, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who we lost on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul 61st
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and influenced countless artists. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically killed on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Lennon Death Tribute
angles.copy: On this day in 1980, the world lost a visionary. Remembering John Lennon and his enduring impact on music and peace.
